preconditions.description: The input is an integer n such that 1 ≤ n ≤ 10^6.

postconditions.description: The output is the number of distinct subarrays of the concatenated permutation sequence P modulo 998244353, where P is formed by concatenating all permutations of integers 1 to n in lexicographic order.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(subarray) <= n * factorial(n) for subarray in subarrays)
postconditions.description: Every subarray is a contiguous subsequence of P with length between 1 and n·n! (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= x <= n for x in subarray) for subarray in subarrays)
postconditions.description: Every element in every subarray is an integer between 1 and n (inclusive).
